Our Background

Eight Years of Solving Healthcare Challenges

Digha-Biomedicals was founded with one clear purpose: to solve the persistent equipment problems faced by Nigerian hospitals. We don't just supply machines — we invent, design, and manufacture technological solutions that assist health experts in providing timely, quality healthcare.

For over eight years, we have been a reliable, low-cost technological pillar for hospitals across Nigeria — providing ready and dependable alternatives to equipment deficiencies and sudden breakdowns that would otherwise halt patient care.

Partnering with Digha Bio-medicals is synonymous with increased return on investment while ensuring hospitals continue to deliver adequate health services to the Nigerian public. Our products are ISO 9001:2000 certified and user-trustworthy.

Beyond biomedicals, our parent company — Digha Mux Limited — also operates divisions in satellite technology, media education, and agriculture, making us a true multi-sector Nigerian innovator.

Our Journey

How We Got Here

Year 1
Founded — Dighamux Nigeria Limited
Incorporated in Nigeria as a Technological Innovation and Inventing Company, with a bold mission to solve medical equipment challenges facing Nigerian hospitals.
Early Years
First Hospital Partnerships
Began supplying and servicing X-ray equipment to hospitals in Anambra State, including Our Lady of Lourdes Ihiala and Toronto Hospital Onitsha — building a reputation for reliability and speed.
Growth Phase
Manufacturing Our Own Equipment
Launched in-house manufacturing of the DM-B3 Ray-Combiner, hybrid solar pumps, and electronic circuit boards — all ISO 9001:2000 certified. Digha became a maker, not just a supplier.
Expansion
National Reach — Abuja & Beyond
Expanded client base to federal hospitals and military medical centers including 82 Division Medical Center Enugu and NAOWA Hospital Asokoro, Abuja.
Recent
Training & Capacity Building
Partnered with MedShare, Coca-Cola Foundation, and Anambra State Government to deliver hands-on biomedical engineering training — 75% practical — for the next generation of Nigerian engineers.
Today
8+ Years & Counting
Serving 20+ hospitals across Nigeria with locally-manufactured biomedical equipment, ongoing maintenance, and engineering excellence. The best is still ahead.
In Action

Our People,
Our Craft

Engineering Training Programs
Hands-on learning sessions where Digha engineers train the next wave of Nigerian biomedical technicians.
Fieldwork & Installation
Our team works directly inside hospital radiology rooms — installing, commissioning, and ensuring every machine is perfect.
In-House Manufacturing
We design and build our own electronic circuit boards and control systems — real engineering, made in Nigeria.
Industry Partnerships
Collaborating with global organizations and state governments to elevate healthcare technology standards across Nigeria.
